about: HCD letters about each Orange County jurisdiction's ADU ordinance or ADU permitting (34 cities + unincorporated county). Found 2026-11-07 by web search of hcd.ca.gov (one search per jurisdiction) plus a check of HCD's 2025-12-05 batch-letter URL pattern for the rest. Every URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-11-07.
caveats: An empty list means none was FOUND, not that none exists. HCD's dashboard (https://www.hcd.ca.gov/hau/enforcement-letters) is the authoritative index but can't be read automatically.
Summaries are short paraphrases from search excerpts and our reading of the Anaheim and Irvine letters; only those two were read in full. Read a letter before relying on it.
Letters show HCD's position at a point in time. A city may have amended its ordinance since; a later letter or the city's response may change the picture.

Kinds: findings (formal findings on an adopted ordinance), technical_assistance, notice_of_potential_violation, notice_of_violation, compliance (HCD closed the matter), city_response, findings_response.

ALISO VIEJO.summary: Ord. 2023-235 noncompliant: deed restriction must go; height, parking, window line-of-sight, subjective design, interior dimensions.

ANAHEIM.summary: ADU Ord. 6570 and SB 9 Ord. 6524 noncompliant (10 ADU + 7 SB 9 findings), incl. deleted 65852.2/.22/.26 citations. See data/hcd-findings.json.

BUENA PARK.summary: Ord. 1674: unit count, size, bedroom and parking rules.
Ord. 1736 noncompliant: SB 1211 multifamily limits, AB 2533 (66332), deleted SB 477 citations, setbacks, ADU combinations.

COSTA MESA.summary: Ord. 2021-03: omits multifamily; 'existing structure' definition creates a de facto wait.
Ord. 2023-03 noncompliant: deleted SB 477 citations, conflict with the 60-day decision rule, one-ADU limit, JADU limits.

DANA POINT.summary: Ord. 21-06: bedroom cap, height and separation rules.
Ord. 23-06 still noncompliant (deed restrictions, multifamily conversions).
Notice of violation: city kept applying its noncompliant ordinance; HCD investigated denied applications.
Second notice of violation: Ord. 25-04 still noncompliant; HCD has not found any Dana Point ADU ordinance compliant.
City's response: maintains compliance but says the council amended the ordinance.

FOUNTAIN VALLEY.summary: Ord. 1603 noncompliant: outdated citations, sprinklers, covenant on separate sale / rental term (unauthorized standard).

GARDEN GROVE.summary: Ord. 2966 (adopted 2025-08-12) noncompliant: conversions, minimum sizes, setbacks/separation, discretionary design review, equipment screening.

HUNTINGTON BEACH.summary: Warned that halting ADU and SB 9 permit processing would violate state law (council later reversed course).

IRVINE.summary: Ord. 18-05 noncompliant (14 findings), incl. 120-day timeline and deed restrictions. See data/hcd-findings.json.
Irvine will rely on State ADU Law instead of amending; may restrict separate sale.

LA HABRA.summary: Ord. 1835: utility rules, separate-sale ban, corner-lot setbacks, building separation.

LAGUNA HILLS.summary: 2019 ordinance; relying on State ADU Law alone isn't enough, HCD recommends repealing the outdated ordinance.

LAGUNA NIGUEL.summary: 2023 ordinance noncompliant: outdated citations, one-ADU limit, deed restriction, owner-occupancy, JADU rental term.

LAGUNA WOODS.summary: Ordinance on file is from 2020 and may be out of compliance; lists law changes.

LAKE FOREST.summary: Ord. 336: efficiency kitchen, separate sale, bedroom cap, door location, JADU utilities.
Ord. 355 satisfactorily addresses HCD's concerns; matter closed.

LOS ALAMITOS.summary: December 2025 batch letter on outdated ADU ordinances (found by URL pattern; not read).

NEWPORT BEACH.summary: Ord. 2023-2 noncompliant: nonconforming conditions, one-per-lot limit, multi-unit lots, height/size, JADU minimum size.

ORANGE.summary: Ord. 03-21: JADU efficiency kitchen, design exceptions, bedroom counts, separate-sale exception.

ORANGE COUNTY.summary: County ordinance on file is from 2020; lists changes incl. deed-restriction ban, HOA limits, 15-business-day completeness.

PLACENTIA.summary: Complaint: city required HOA approval for completeness; HCD says third-party (HOA) involvement violates State ADU Law.

RANCHO SANTA MARGARITA.summary: Ord. 21-02: 220 sq ft minimum (efficiency units allowed at 150), height tied to primary structure.

SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO.summary: Ord. 1077: efficiency kitchen, fees, separate conveyance, bedroom cap, design rules, historic, utilities.

SEAL BEACH.summary: Ord. 1690: multifamily, height below 16 ft, minor use permit, JADU size, separate sale.
Ord. 1706 noncompliant: deleted SB 477 citations, one ADU category per lot, 50% size cap, deed restriction, owner-occupancy.

VILLA PARK.summary: Ord. 2023-630 noncompliant: SB 1211/AB 2533 changes, outdated numbering, rear setback, parking exceptions.

WESTMINSTER.summary: Ord. 2572: zones, number per lot, height, JADU zoning.
HCD reply on JADUs: only allowed in single-family zones.

YORBA LINDA.summary: Ordinance on file is from 2020 and may be out of compliance; lists law changes.
